title: plan-runner BLOCK to re-plan loop: feed auditor findings back, cap N=2, deterministic recovery (CAM-151 Half B never shipped)
description: Recurring toil (3+ sessions: CAM-160, CAM-162, CAM-203 on 2026-07-06). On auditor BLOCK, runPostAudit (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:817-823) fires notifyFn + escalateFn and returns escalated; the phase resets to idle with plan_issue null and there is NO re-plan. plan-runner.ts:27 and :789 state explicitly that it does NOT implement a BLOCK to re-plan loop (CAM-151 Half B). But CAM-151 is marked shipped with a body promising exactly that loop (re-spawn planner with the findings, cap N=2 rounds, escalate to operator on non-convergence). Result: the meta-loop parks at idle on every BLOCK and the operator re-dispatches /cam-plan by hand every cycle. Compounding: the escalations only channel to the orchestrator is the send-keys pane push (notifyFn), which CAM-200 shows lands in the composer without submitting, so the orchestrator does not even reliably learn of the BLOCK. Fix (deterministic TS, mirrors the review loop in loop.ts: FIXES_PENDING to re-implement to MAX_ROUNDS terminal). (1) On audit-blocked, capture scripts/cam/plan-verdict-report.json (cleared on next plan at plan-runner.ts:254) and re-spawn the planner with those findings fed into its prompt, cap N=2 rounds. (2) Escalate to the operator only on non-convergence after N rounds, never infinite-loop. (3) Make the terminal escalation durable-file/event based, not solely the pane push, so a dropped CAM-200 push does not lose the BLOCK and the orchestrator derives it on wake (CAM-195 style). (4) Kill planner+auditor panes on BOTH plan terminals (APPROVE to branch AND BLOCK to re-plan/escalate), folding the plan-path half of CAM-167 so the 2-pane mutex self-heals. Cross-refs: supersedes CAM-151 Half B (shipped but never delivered); complements CAM-200 (push delivery reliability); folds plan-path of CAM-167 (pane teardown); CAM-195 (evented terminals the orch derives on wake).

spec.scope: IN: a deterministic BLOCK->re-plan loop inside the plan-runner (runPostAudit / runPlanPhase, src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts). On an auditor audit-blocked verdict, capture the plan-verdict-report.json findings before they are cleared, re-spawn the planner with those findings injected into its prompt, cap at N=2 re-plan rounds, and on non-convergence return a terminal escalated result plus a durable escalation event/marker the orchestrator derives on wake (not solely the send-keys push). Kill the planner and auditor panes on every plan terminal (APPROVE->branch, each re-plan boundary, escalate). Mirror the review-loop control-flow in src/supervisor/loop.ts (FIXES_PENDING->re-implement->MAX_ROUNDS terminal). OUT: fixing the send-keys delivery bug itself (CAM-200); the rest of the CAM-167 pane teardown (supervisor/reviewer panes); any MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT-style proceed-with-debt for plans (a blocked PRD never proceeds); a repeated-findings-between-rounds guard (explicitly descoped).
acceptanceCriteria: On an audit-blocked verdict, runPlanPhase re-spawns the planner with the prior round's plan-verdict-report.json findings injected into its spawn prompt, for up to N=2 rounds (round 1 has no prior findings; round 2+ carries them), and a round that APPROVEs proceeds to branch. [oracle: named-command bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

The re-plan captures the auditor findings BEFORE plan-runner clears plan-verdict-report.json (plan-runner.ts:254), so the round-2 planner prompt contains the non-empty prior findings. [oracle: named-command bun test asserting round-2 prompt carries the prior findings]

After N=2 consecutive non-converging BLOCK rounds, runPlanPhase returns a terminal escalated result (never auto-branches a blocked PRD) and writes a durable escalation event/marker carrying the issue id and last findings, derivable by the orchestrator on wake without the send-keys pane push (CAM-200-independent). [oracle: named-command bun test + file-assert on the escalation marker]

The planner and auditor panes are killed on every plan terminal (APPROVE->branch, each re-plan boundary, and escalate) so no worker pane lingers and the 2-pane mutex is restored. [oracle: named-command bun test asserting kill-pane is invoked for planner+auditor on all three paths]
bun run check:all is green (typecheck + biome + tests). [oracle: named-command bun run check:all]
gotchas: plan-runner.ts:254 clears plan-verdict-report.json + prd.json at the START of the plan phase; the re-plan loop MUST read/capture the findings before this clear on each round.
runPostAudit (plan-runner.ts:817-823) currently returns escalated on audit-blocked with no re-plan; lines 27 and 789 document the absence. That return site is where the loop is inserted.
Unlike the review loop, a non-converged PLAN never proceeds: there is no plan analog of MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT / ship-with-debt. The terminal on non-convergence is escalated, never branch.
CAM-151 is marked shipped but delivered only Half A (escalate + notify); its promised Half B re-plan loop is what THIS issue implements. Do not assume the code already contains the loop.

The escalation must NOT depend on notifyFn send-keys (CAM-200: the push lands in the composer without submitting). Emit a durable event/marker the orchestrator reads on wake (CAM-195 style); the pane push is a best-effort nudge only.
The planner does not read patterns.md or plan-verdict-report.json on its own; the ONLY channel to inform it is its spawn prompt string, so the findings must be injected there.

The auditor handback is plan-verdict-report.json (subagent-auditor exit-report protocol): { verdict, summary, findings[]{id,category,severity,storyId,description,suggestion}, metrics }. Feed description + suggestion of each finding into the re-plan prompt.
domainTerms: re-plan round: one planner+auditor cycle triggered after an audit-blocked verdict, feeding the prior round's findings back into the planner spawn prompt; capped at N=2.

plan escalation: the terminal state when a PRD fails to converge (still audit-blocked) after N re-plan rounds; the orchestrator surfaces it to the operator via a durable marker and never auto-proceeds to branch.

findings feedback: injecting the auditor's plan-verdict-report.json findings (description + suggestion per finding) into the next planner spawn's prompt so the planner corrects the flagged defects instead of regenerating the PRD blind.
